title: ScriptResult
description: script-worker -> guardian: terminal result of one invocation. `resolved`/`rejected` come from the legacy resolve/reject protocol (first call wins); `error` is an uncaught synchronous exception; `timeout` is reported by the guardian, never by the worker. `ops` is the ordered list of side effects the script produced (logs, field mutations, dialog requests already answered); guardian/backend apply them in order.
